prompt: Create an original 60 second pastoral acoustic instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: concert harp, flute, viola. Style: rolling harp figures and long woodwind answers. Tempo approximately 84 BPM; C major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and whimsical instrumental piece with a folk-classical fusion feel. It features a prominent flute melody, supported by pizzicato and bowed strings, and light percussion, creating an upbeat and traditional atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首活泼而异想天开的器乐作品，融合了民间与古典风格。它以悠扬的长笛旋律为主，辅以拨弦和弓弦乐器以及轻柔的打击乐，营造出欢快而传统的氛围。
